newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: KL palm oil ends up on technical rebound,data talk.
newsitem.headline: KL palm oil ends up on technical rebound,data talk.

text.p: PALM OIL FUTURES PALM OIL PHYSICAL

PALM OIL FUTURES - Prices rebounded and closed marginally up on technical rebound and talk of a higher than expected June 1-10 export data. Shortcovering and buying appeared at lower levels, but underlying sentiment is weak as Aug is trading below 1,200 riggit level. Trading range is 1,165 and 1,200.
PALM OIL PHYSICALS - Also saw interest among nearbys CPOs with prices holding relatively steady.
The contract was five ringgit up at 1,179 ringgit ($468.88) a tonne after falling to a low of 1,168.
"The market expects August to rise to 1,180 ringgit and then to 1,200 ringgit," a trader said.
Marginal gains were posted in most futures contracts.
Traders said gains would be limited on market belief that the underlying sentiment is still be bearish as the third month is trading below the psychological level of 1,200 ringgit.
Traders described the recovery to some fresh buying at the lower levels after there was talk of a higher-than-expected June 1-10 exports.
"We think the June 1-10 exports were estimated at between 170,000 and 190,000 tonnes," a trader said.

Physicals June (south) saw offers at 1,212.50 ringgit against bids at 1,207.50 after trading from 1,202.50 and 1,210, and June (central) at 1,195 versus 1,190 with earlier trades from 1,187.50 to 1,195.
July (south) saw offers at 1,212.50 after bids of 1,207.50 and trade of 1,207.50 and 1,210.
July (central) saw offers at 1,195 against bids of 1,190.
In refined products, June RBD palm oil was offered at $515.50, July $510 and Aug/Sept at $505.
June RBD palm olein saw offers at $555, July at $552.50 and Aug/Sept at $550. July was traded at $552.
July RBD palm stearin was offered at $377.50 and June/July palm fatty acid distillate saw sellers at $267.50.
